witnesses.check: cooling branch: overheated (r13b) -> needs_reload_after_overheat byte [rdi+0x90] == 0 -> cool by [rdi+0x8C] * dt; not overheated and idle -> [rdi+0x80]
recovery: overheated, temperature <= [rdi+0x64] and [rdi+0x90] == 0 clears the overheated byte (state + 8)

witnesses.note: one control-flow change: when the per-instance input at [+0x50 list]+72i+0xC is non-zero (the beam powering up / winding down) build 26088801 skips cooling (jp/jne -> 0x76E4BE) where 25480438 went to the overheated-rate branch (0x76300F). With the mod an overheated Laser Sentry therefore does not cool during those ~0.7 s; the upstream comment (lines 20-21) describing extra cooling then no longer holds. The overheated, idle path the mod relies on is unchanged.

witnesses.check: ability script switch old 0x11509E0: dec edx; cmp edx, 0xB32 (2867 ids); new 0xFE38D0: cmp edx, 0xB44 (2885 ids)

0x1150660 -> 0xFE3550 by a unique exact window
new: exactly one id dispatches to 0xFE3550: 2884
the handler body is aligned with no operand difference

witnesses.note: the ability enum grew by 18 below this id (2867 -> 2885 cases). Whether the record in the build-26088801 data holds 2884 is game data (generated_entities.dl_bin is encrypted); Cooldown.inspect refuses unless the record holds exactly ABILITY_VANILLA (or the full change), so a wrong value fails closed and restore only ever writes back bytes that were read there.

rows.name: STATE_STUCK 6 (no update), POWER_UP 7 (power-up state), firing 13
rows.method: dispatcher state tables of old 308 / new 309 compared

witnesses.check: old 308 / new 309 state switch: states 6, 11 and 12 go straight to the dispatcher exit (no update)
state 1 (deployed): after 2 s set_state(7) (both)
state 7 (power up): same handler shape (test [block+0x1E0] bit 1 -> 8, ...)
states 8-10 share one handler, 13 (firing) calls its own function (old 0x32A3D0 / new 0x3310D0)

witnesses.note: that the firing state (new 0x3310D0) leaves for 6 when its weapon overheats: its page (0x331000) is still encrypted in every new capture (game-26088801*.dll, transmog-live-text.bin, diverkit-port/game-live-text.bin). The mod writes only when the block reads state 6 and no request is pending, so a different overheat state means no write ("turret in state N").
